tasks.instruction: You've just heard about Astro from a friend who mentioned they use it to watch sports and local dramas. You decide to check it out for the first time. Look around this page. When you're ready, tell us: what do you understand about what Astro offers? Is there anything you'd want to do or look at next — and why?
tasks.response:
Astro... okay I know Astro. My family has been with Astro for many years. But this page — it looks different from what I know. Before, Astro needed a dish. Now they say 'No box required'? I don't understand. If no box, how do I watch? On what? The TV? The phone? My children would know but I don't.

'Endless streaming with Astro One' — streaming, I know this word because my children use it. So this is like the way they watch Netflix? Okay.

Entertainment Zero — RM49.99 a month. What is Zero? I thought Zero means nothing. So why am I paying RM49.99 for Zero? This name is very confusing to me. I would ask my son what this means.

The page is all in English. I can read but I feel more comfortable in Bahasa. If this is for Malaysian families, why is everything in English only? I would prefer if there is a Bahasa option.

I see 'No box required. Cancel anytime. Pay as you stream monthly. Stream on up to 2 devices.' Okay, 2 devices. But in my house we have the big TV in the living room, my husband's phone, my phone, my daughter's tablet. Two devices is not enough for a family.

I see the WhatsApp button — 'We are here for you'. This I like. I would WhatsApp to ask someone to explain this to me before I do anything. I always prefer to talk to someone first.

I also see 'Compare all packs'. Maybe there is a family pack? I would want to look at that.

eval.confusion_signal: Multiple confusion points: 'Zero' name is meaningless/counterintuitive; 'No box required' creates uncertainty about how viewing works; English-only page creates mild disengagement; 2-device limit misaligns with family household needs.
eval.trust_signal: positive anchor — WhatsApp support button strongly noticed and valued. Existing Astro brand familiarity provides baseline comfort.
eval.brand_comprehension: partial — understood it's streaming but unclear on practical setup without box
eval.value_proposition_clarity: vague — RM49.99 for 'Zero' communicates nothing meaningful; device limit is already a household concern
eval.visual_hierarchy_effectiveness: off-target — device limit (2 devices) noticed as problem early; family content not surfaced; BM content not visible
eval.information_gaps: Is there Bahasa Malaysia content? Is there a family pack with more devices? What does 'no box' mean practically — do I need a Smart TV? What about my current Astro subscription?

tasks.instruction: You're looking for a TV subscription for your household. You watch a mix of sports, movies, and local content. Browse through what's available here. Tell us what stands out, what's confusing, and what — if anything — would make you want to take action. If nothing appeals to you, explain what's missing or holding you back.
tasks.response:
Okay I see three choices. Entertainment 12, Sports 12, Epic 24. The numbers — 12, 12, 24 — what does this mean? My daughter would say it is the number of months of contract. So this is not cancel anytime? The homepage said cancel anytime but now it says 12 months contract? I am confused. Is this different from the Entertainment Zero?

Entertainment 12 — RM39.99 a month. That is cheaper than RM49.99 from before. But it says 12-month contract. I don't know if this is good or not. What channels do I get? I don't see Astro Prima. I don't see anything about Malay drama. Just 'Base | View more'. I need to know what is inside before I can decide.

Sports 12 — RM69.99. My husband watches football. Maybe this is for him. But RM70 a month is a lot. And again, 12 months contract. What if the service is not good? Then we are stuck for one year.

Epic 24 — RM159.99 and I see 24-month contract. I cannot commit to 2 years. That is too long. What if something changes? Also RM160 a month is too much. Right now my Astro bill is around RM90-100. For RM160 I would need to be very sure.

I see Netflix and Disney+ logos on the Epic pack. My children use Netflix. So maybe this saves us money if we combine? But I would need my husband to calculate this with me. I would not decide this by myself.

I still have many questions. I would WhatsApp the customer service to ask: What is inside each pack? Is there Bahasa Malaysia channel? Can I use my existing Astro subscription and just add this? This page does not answer these questions.

eval.confusion_signal: Contract contradiction with homepage (cancel anytime vs 12-month contract). Pack number naming opaque. No Bahasa Malaysia / local drama channel visibility. Device count not shown for Entertainment/Sports packs. Epic 24 duration too long for risk-averse persona.
eval.abandon_trigger: Contract contradiction discovered (homepage vs pack page). Cannot see local content channels. Would not decide without spousal input and customer service clarification.
eval.trust_signal: negative — perceived contradiction between homepage promise and pack page terms erodes existing Astro goodwill
eval.pack_differentiation_clarity: confused — could separate by price but could not match any pack to household needs without channel list
eval.personal_relevance: no — no pack visibly addressed family, local drama, or Bahasa content needs

session_summary: Puan Rohani engaged genuinely and with intent to potentially subscribe, but accumulated 6+ confusion signals across both tasks. The contract contradiction (homepage: cancel anytime vs pack page: 12-month contract) was the critical friction point. Absence of visible local/BM content and unclear device limits for family use prevented any shortlisting. Would escalate to WhatsApp support rather than convert alone — high support cost risk. This is the highest-value persona to fix for.
h1_verdict: falsified — could not differentiate packs without channel detail; contract contradiction blocked confidence to commit
